mapper.select: SELECT activity_type, xp, point, daily_limit, once_per_account FROM site_reward_rules
SELECT level, name, required_xp, levelup_bonus_point FROM site_reward_levels ORDER BY level
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO site_reward_ledger (user_id, reward_key, source_type, xp_delta, point_delta, reward_date, ref_code, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{rewardKey}, #{sourceType}, #{xpDelta}, #{pointDelta}, #{rewardDate}, #{refCode}, #{reason}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(xp_delta), 0) AS xp_delta, COALESCE(SUM(point_delta), 0) AS point_delta FROM site_reward_ledger WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_reward_activity (user_id, activity_type, reward_date, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{date}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, category, bonus_point, signup_from, signup_to, grant_end FROM site_titles WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT id, code, name, category, bonus_point FROM site_titles ORDER BY id

SELECT t.id, t.code, t.name, t.category, t.bonus_point, ut.equipped, ut.granted_at FROM site_user_titles ut JOIN site_titles t ON t.id = ut.title_id WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ut.granted_at, t.id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO site_user_titles (user_id, title_id, equipped, granted_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{titleId}, 0, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM site_user_titles WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND title_id = #{titleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE site_user_titles SET equipped = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND equipped = 1
UPDATE site_user_titles SET equipped = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND title_id = #{titleId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM site_users WHERE public_id = #{publicId}
SELECT user_role FROM site_users WHERE id = #{userId}
SELECT public_id FROM site_users WHERE id = #{userId}
SELECT id, public_id, created_at, last_login_at FROM site_users WHERE user_status = 'ACTIVE' AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM site_user_event WHERE created_at >= #{since} AND user_id IS NOT NULL
